title: PTCG-Bench: Can LLM Agents Master Pok\'emon Trading Card Game?
abstract: arXiv:2605.29653v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Given a strategically complex board game, human players can quickly learn to devise strategies after playing a few rounds. Autonomous agents require similar capabilities in realistic interactive environments, yet existing agent benchmarks often fail to fully capture such strategic and evolving decision-making scenarios. We present PTCG-Bench, a benchmark built on the Pok'{e}mon Trading Card Game (PTCG) that evaluates LLM agents at two complementary levels: (1) their decision-making performance within a single complex environment, and (2) their ability to self-evolving through accumulated experience. We further include a modular harness ablation to better interpret agent performance without conflating it with model capability. Our experiments show that, although LLM agents can achieve non-trivial gameplay performance, sustained and stable self-evolution remains challenging, and performance is sensitive to harness design. translated_title: PTCG-Bench：LLM智能体能掌握宝可梦集换式卡牌游戏吗？
translated_abstract: 面对一款策略复杂的棋盘游戏，人类玩家只需玩几局就能快速学会制定策略。自主智能体在真实交互环境中也需要具备类似的能力，然而现有的智能体基准测试往往无法充分捕捉这种策略性且不断演化的决策场景。我们提出了PTCG-Bench，这是一个基于宝可梦集换式卡牌游戏（PTCG）构建的基准，从两个互补的层面评估LLM智能体：（1）在单一复杂环境中的决策表现；（2）通过积累经验实现自我进化的能力。我们还进一步纳入了模块化的harness消融实验，以便在不将智能体表现与模型能力混为一谈的情况下更好地解读智能体的表现。我们的实验表明，尽管LLM智能体能够取得不俗的游戏表现，但持续且稳定的自我进化仍然具有挑战性，且性能对harness设计十分敏感。我们希望……
tldr: PTCG-Bench是基于宝可梦集换式卡牌游戏构建的基准，从复杂环境中的决策表现和通过经验积累实现自我进化两个互补层面评估LLM智能体，实验发现智能体虽能取得不俗的游戏表现，但持续稳定的自我进化仍然困难，且性能对harness设计高度敏感。
en_tdlr: PTCG-Bench is a benchmark built on the Pokémon Trading Card Game that evaluates LLM agents at two complementary levels—decision-making within a complex environment and self-evolution through accumulated experience—revealing that while agents achieve non-trivial gameplay performance, sustained and stable self-evolution remains challenging and is sensitive to harness design.
